How much is the departure fee for passen.answer:
A departure fee of seventy-five dirhams (AED 75.00) will be collected from every passenger departing the United Arab Emirates through Dubai airports [1]. Passengers below the age of two (2) years are exempted from payment of the fee [1]. On-duty pilots and cabin crew are exempted from payment of the fee [1]. Transit passengers whose arrival and departure flight number is the same are exempted from payment of the fee [1]. Transfer passengers whose final destination is not the United Arab Emirates and whose departure is within twenty-four (24) hours from the time of arrival are exempted from payment of the fee [1].
